howEachWasRepaired.REPEATING_ROWS: The platform holds no code, no section and no offence type for the conviction — the field map refuses all fifteen of those cells and the packet-set manifest sends the participant to the court docket for them — so the held facts do not permit writing row 1. The route's two writes into row 1 (Reduce1 = the 17(b) yes/no, Offense1 = the 17(d)(2) yes/no) are therefore withdrawn and the whole row is left empty, as the form's own instruction requires. Nothing was invented. The withdrawal is per-family, behind withdrawRouteTextControlsForRowIntegrity, set only on this family; the other four CR-180 families on the host write no conviction-table cell at all.
howEachWasRepaired.SELF_HELP_STOP: The packet carried one of the four stop conditions the committed track registry holds for trackId ca-17b-reduction. All four are now printed in the registry's own words, together with its postGenerationHandoffs line distinguishing a routine hearing from a contested one.
howEachWasRepaired.FEE_AND_WAIVER: The packet said waiver was not established. The committed manifest names FW-001 as the general California fee waiver form, and that is now printed as a separate form the participant asks the clerk for. No fee figure is published: the manifest records the fee as "Unresolved and county-specific. Do not publish a figure.", so the clerk still answers the amount.
howEachWasRepaired.SERVICE: The packet said who and how were not established. The manifest names the prosecuting attorney and CR-106, and the registry's rules.notice states the timing ("The prosecuting attorney must be given 15 days' notice of the petition the reduction is bundled with."). Both are printed verbatim and the clerk question is narrowed to the service method alone, which neither record states.
